description:
The Huffy Woodhaven 24" Cruiser Bike is built for relaxed rides through the neighborhood, park paths, and everyday errands. Its durable steel frame provides steady support while the comfortable riding position helps riders feel confident and at ease wherever the day leads.
A convenient front basket and rear rack make it easy to bring along essentials for every ride. Carry books, small bags, or everyday items while cruising to a friend’s house or heading out for a relaxing ride around the neighborhood.
The easy-to-use coaster brake allows riders to stop by simply pedaling backward, helping build confidence and control. Combined with wide tires, upright handlebars, and a cushioned saddle, the Woodhaven delivers a smooth and comfortable ride every time.

components.description: Easy Coaster Brake: Simple pedal-back braking helps riders stop confidently and stay in control.
